label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), early in episode
explanation: Sparse (0.9% of steps). 94% of activation mass is at D2 with S2 shown, and almost all of it after choosing a2 (common a2->S2). It never fires at D1, on S1, or when the reward input is 1; there is a small tail at GO (6% of mass). It fades over the episode: rate is 6.7x in trials 0-9 and zero after trial ~60. The predicate D2 & a2 & S2 & ep_trial<50 covers 93% of mass but precision is only ~13%: most such steps are inactive. Within runs of repeated a2->S2c trials it is strongest on the first one or two and then decays, which is why excluding trials preceded by two a2->S2 trials keeps 87% of mass (precision 15%). It is somewhat higher after a switch (stay==0, 4.6x lift) and when value is high. What decides activation beyond this is probably the GRU state (an episode-time / novelty signal), not any single task variable. Magnitude was not checked beyond the quartile coverage, which is fairly even. Uses only observed variables.
